items.q: Can you really make money taking online surveys?
items.a: Yes, but think of it as pocket money, not a salary. Most people earn a few dollars a day from surveys on legit sites like Swagbucks, more if they combine surveys with cashback and other paid tasks.
Yes. Swagbucks has been paying members since 2008 in cash and gift cards and is available in the US, UK, Canada, Australia and Ireland. It is free to join and you never have to pay to take surveys.

items.q: How do I get the Swagbucks welcome bonus?
items.a: Sign up for a free account through one of our links. New members get a $5 welcome bonus on Swagbucks; the exact terms are set by Swagbucks and shown on the sign-up page.

items.q: What are the best ways to make money offline?
items.a: Pet sitting, dog walking, babysitting, cleaning, yard work, reselling thrift finds, tutoring and food or grocery delivery are some of the fastest offline side hustles to start with little or no money.
